dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 安娜，你看，外面下雪了！

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 等一下，你穿得太少了，外面很冷。

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 别生病了，再穿一件吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Bié shēng bìng le, zài chuān yí jiàn ba.
dialogue.english: Don't go getting sick. Put on one more.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好吧，听你的。

dialogue.english: All right, you win.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我妻子做饭做得很好，今天你多吃一点儿。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ qīzi zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo, jīntiān nǐ duō chī yìdiǎnr.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 太谢谢你们了！
dialogue.pinyin: Tài xièxie nǐmen le!
dialogue.english: Thank you both so much!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 王明，你弟弟今年多大了？
dialogue.pinyin: Wáng Míng, nǐ dìdi jīnnián duō dà le?
dialogue.english: Wang Ming, how old is your younger brother this year?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 十六岁，比我小五岁。
dialogue.pinyin: Shíliù suì, bǐ wǒ xiǎo wǔ suì.
dialogue.english: Sixteen, five years younger than me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 他的学校离你家远吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Tā de xuéxiào lí nǐ jiā yuǎn ma?
dialogue.english: Is his school far from your home?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不远，很近，走路十分钟就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, hěn jìn, zǒu lù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
dialogue.english: Not far, it's very close. It's only a ten-minute walk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 他学习怎么样？
dialogue.pinyin: Tā xuéxí zěnmeyàng?
dialogue.english: How is he doing at school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 他学习很好，跑步也跑得很快。他还比我高呢！
dialogue.pinyin: Tā xuéxí hěn hǎo, pǎo bù yě pǎo de hěn kuài. Tā hái bǐ wǒ gāo ne!
dialogue.english: He's a good student and a fast runner too. He's even taller than me!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 今天北京零下八度，我家那儿是二十五度。
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān Běijīng líng xià bā dù, wǒ jiā nàr shì èrshíwǔ dù.
dialogue.english: Today it's minus eight degrees in Beijing; back home it's twenty-five.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 北京没有我家那儿热，可是我很喜欢北京的雪。
dialogue.pinyin: Běijīng méiyǒu wǒ jiā nàr rè, kěshì wǒ hěn xǐhuan Běijīng de xuě.
dialogue.english: Beijing isn't as warm as my hometown, but I love Beijing's snow.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 今天的雪比昨天的还大。
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān de xuě bǐ zuótiān de hái dà.
dialogue.english: Today's snow is even heavier than yesterday's.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我穿了很多衣服，走得很慢。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ chuānle hěn duō yīfu, zǒu de hěn màn.
dialogue.english: I'm wearing lots of clothes, so I walk very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 王明说，明天会比今天还冷，可能零下十度。
dialogue.pinyin: Wáng Míng shuō, míngtiān huì bǐ jīntiān hái lěng, kěnéng líng xià shí dù.
dialogue.english: Wang Ming says tomorrow will be even colder than today, maybe minus ten.

explanation.hanzi: "动词＋得＋形容词短语"用来评价一个动作做得怎么样，比如"说得很快"、"穿得太少"。如果动词有宾语，要重复动词："做饭做得很好"，或者把宾语放在前面："饭做得很好"。否定是"动词＋得＋不＋形容词"；问题可以用"动词＋得＋怎么样"。
explanation.english: "Verb + 得 + adjective phrase" comments on how an action is done: 说得很快 "speaks fast", 穿得太少 "isn't wearing enough". The adjective usually takes 很, 太 or another degree word. If the verb has an object, repeat the verb (做饭做得很好), or put the object first and drop the first verb (饭做得很好). For the negative, put 不 after 得: 唱得不好 "doesn't sing well". To ask, use 得怎么样？

examples.pinyin: Liú lǎoshī shuō de hěn màn.
Wǒ qīzi zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo.

examples.english: How well does Mark speak Chinese?

examples.pinyin: Tā chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo.

explanation.hanzi: 在"A 比 B + 形容词"里，可以在形容词前面加"更"或者"还"，意思是 B 已经很怎么样了，A 比 B 程度更高。"还"的语气比"更"强，常常带有意外的感觉。否定比较常用"A 没有 B + 形容词"，意思是 A 不如 B。
explanation.english: In "A 比 B + adjective" you can put 更 (gèng) or 还 (hái) before the adjective to mean "even more": B is already quite something, and A goes further. 还 is a bit stronger and often sounds surprised: 他还比我高呢！"He's even taller than me!" (Remember: never 很 here.) To say A is not as ... as B, use "A 没有 B + adjective": 北京没有我家那儿热 "Beijing isn't as hot as my hometown."

prompt.hanzi: 两人一组，谈谈天气和衣服。
prompt.english: In pairs, talk about the weather and what to wear.

activities: Weather comparison: each partner picks a city. Compare today's temperatures with 比……还…… and 没有……, e.g. 北京没有……热.
Get-dressed advice: A describes the weather (下雪了, 零下……度); B checks what A is wearing and comments with 你穿得太少了 / 穿得很漂亮.
Talent show: say how well people you know do things with 得: 我弟弟唱歌唱得……, 我妈妈做饭做得…….
Visiting a home: role-play arriving at a friend's place in the snow (请进！外面冷吧？), meeting family members, and saying thank you.
